extracted.intended_audience: readers, writers, and critics of literary fiction seeking qualities to emulate or look for in books
extracted.subtask_description: Extracted evaluative criteria and virtues for fiction and literary prose as implied by the catalogue blurbs and critical quotations on the page. Useful for authors aiming to produce or editors/critics assessing literary work.

rubrics_metrics.name: First-hand knowledge and detailed accuracy
rubrics_metrics.description: Descriptions based on direct experience that are 'astounding' in their accuracy and detail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use lived experience or careful research to render settings and cultures with precision; avoid vague or stereotyped depictions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Freshness and vigour of outlook
rubrics_metrics.description: A fresh, vigorous outlook in voice and perspective that keeps writing lively ('all the freshness and vigour of outlook').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Favor original perspectives and energetic phrasing over tired tropes; maintain a dynamic narrative stance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vivid, memorable characters
rubrics_metrics.description: Characters drawn so vividly they 'linger in the memory' or seem 'almost violently alive'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create distinctive behaviours, gestures, and speech; ensure characters have interiority and specificity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authenticity of everyday life and ordinary goodness
rubrics_metrics.description: Portrayal of ordinary people and settings with sympathy and recognition of underlying goodness ('fundamental goodness hidden in the most unpromising of human soil').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid caricature; show complexity and moral depth in ordinary characters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wit and insight
rubrics_metrics.description: Writing that combines wit with penetrating insight into people or situations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use irony and sharp observation to illuminate character or theme without undercutting seriousness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarity, restraint, and the 'plain tale'
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to tell a simple, clear narrative well ('to tell the plain tale... remarkably well').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resist unnecessary ornamentation; let the story and characters carry weight rather than authorial showiness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intimacy and subtle judgment
rubrics_metrics.description: An intimate tone with sure judgment, 'touch light and prim', and a quiet authority of taste.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cultivate a tone that invites close reading and conveys confidence without grandstanding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exact, clean, and musical prose
rubrics_metrics.description: Prose described as exact, clean and 'full of music'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attend to sentence-level economy, cadence, and sound; revise for precision and tonal music.

rubrics_metrics.name: Whimsical originality and workmanship
rubrics_metrics.description: Original voice and inventive choice combined with 'exquisite workmanship'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value both novelty of idea and craftsmanship in execution; eccentricity should be controlled and purposeful.

rubrics_metrics.name: Substance and charm in criticism/essay
rubrics_metrics.description: Critical writing that is both substantial and charming rather than merely flashy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Balance seriousness of argument with an engaging style; don't sacrifice rigor for charm.

rubrics_metrics.name: Individual observational eye
rubrics_metrics.description: Bringing a distinctive 'individual eye' to bear—original observation and perspective of the writer as an artist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Develop personal observational habits and a particular angle on familiar material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Imaginative power and plausibility of the unreal
rubrics_metrics.description: Imaginative re-creation so vivid that even supernatural elements carry 'shock and conviction'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ground imaginative or supernatural elements in sensory detail and coherent internal logic so they feel convincing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cultural and character authenticity
rubrics_metrics.description: Confident, vigorous depiction of characters from different cultures ('whether his characters are Chinese or European').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research, empathy, and careful rendering of speech/behavior to avoid flattening or exoticizing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Iconoclasm and candid thought
rubrics_metrics.description: Clear, candid expression of ideas that challenges sentimentality and received opinion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Write assertively and honestly about controversial or unfashionable ideas while grounding claims in argument or character.

rubrics_metrics.name: Universal themes arising from particular events
rubrics_metrics.description: Narratives that begin with specific historical or local events but reveal 'certain universal qualities'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the particular to illuminate larger human patterns; avoid didactic generalisation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy and 'saying just enough'
rubrics_metrics.description: Essays and stories that 'say just enough of the subject' and reward rereading.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Trim redundancy; let implication and nuance carry meaning so readers discover new layers on re-read.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rereadability and sustained pleasure
rubrics_metrics.description: Work that readers will return to 'again and again' because of layered interest or craft.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Build texture—imagery, theme, and craft elements—that reveal more on subsequent readings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grace of manner and sanity of thought
rubrics_metrics.description: Combination of elegant expression with sound, sane ideas—'combined grace of manner and sanity of thought'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pair refined stylistic choices with coherent, reasonable argument or portrayal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection and curation that clarifies a writer's aim
rubrics_metrics.description: An anthology or selection that shows how verse reflects life or purposefully frames an author ('designed to show...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When curating, choose works that collectively illuminate a theme or a writer's development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Observational completeness and dramatic rendering
rubrics_metrics.description: An author whose eye misses nothing and whose mind turns 'all things to drama'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Observe widely and shape detail into dramatic scenes; avoid inert catalogue of facts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoidance of mere cleverness; sincerity
rubrics_metrics.description: Books praised for having 'no straining after effect' and 'no hint of mere cleverness'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize sincerity and truthfulness over flashy formal tricks used solely to impress.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quest for meaning and thematic depth
rubrics_metrics.description: Narratives that pursue a search for meaning and beauty, disengaging theme from mere plot adventure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Weave thematic inquiry into plot and characterization rather than appending it as an afterthought.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tenderness, poignant humour, and beauty of tone
rubrics_metrics.description: Combination of tenderness, touches of grave or poignant humour, and an overall 'beautiful' book feeling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Balance pathos and humour to achieve emotional subtlety and tonal elegance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delicacy of feeling and insight
rubrics_metrics.description: Delicate emotional perception coupled with penetrating insight into subjects or characters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Show restraint in emotional description; let delicate detail convey depth of feeling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of vernacular/close-to-spoken-language style
rubrics_metrics.description: Aiming to be 'unliterary'—close to the spoken language of characters for authenticity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopt dialect and cadence appropriately to character and context, preserving readability and respect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy of language and incisive detail selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Avoiding unnecessary words while packing in exactly the right details with intensity of feeling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prune excess; select details that both reveal character and advance mood or theme.

rubrics_metrics.name: Suitability to audience/purpose (curation for traveller/readers)
rubrics_metrics.description: Selections made for practical suitability (e.g., anthologies 'specially selected for the traveller').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When assembling or writing for a specific audience, tailor length, tone, and content to their situation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tonal balance of tragedy and comedy
rubrics_metrics.description: Mixing tragedy and comedy so that plays or stories are 'tragedies with the texture of comedy'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manage tone shifts carefully so that comic elements deepen rather than undercut tragic resonance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compactness, harmony, and precise imaginative phrase
rubrics_metrics.description: Work that is 'compact, harmonious' with 'precise and imaginative' expression and 'priceless phrase[s]'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aim for structural economy and harmony between parts; cultivate memorable sentences without ornament for its own sake.

rubrics_metrics.name: Panoramic cohesion from character studies
rubrics_metrics.description: A sequence of intimate character portraits that 'blends into a fascinating panorama of living characters'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure individual sketches cohere into a larger thematic or narrative whole rather than feeling disjointed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emotional honesty and simplicity of portraiture
rubrics_metrics.description: Honesty, delicacy and simplicity create a strong emotional grip on readers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be candid and simple in depiction when appropriate; excessive artifice can distance the reader.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sensory detail and evocation of place
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of sounds, scents, and visual detail to evoke setting (e.g., 'a whiff of crushed thyme... dew on dust').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Employ the five senses selectively to root scenes in a convincing physical world.

rubrics_metrics.name: Influence and intertextual resonance
rubrics_metrics.description: Works that supply memorable incidents or imagery that influence later art (e.g., source of motifs in other famous works).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create distinctive images or episodes that resonate beyond the work; be conscious of literary antecedents.
